This was a great option for my daughters baby shower! It’s a perfect size, great value, very easy to open and use. The cork closure doesn’t allow leaking and it doesn’t fall out easily. Very functional product. We actually put mints inside the jars and tied a horseshoe around the top rim with burlap string for good luck. It made a great keepsake for the attendees of the baby shower.These are so cute! We used them to make home made bath salts for party favors and they came out so beautifully! They’re a nice enough size to also use them for orange juice classes or to serve yogurt parfait at party. Love it!!These are so much more than I expected! They are a nice large size. I plan to fill them with loose leaf tea as a gift at my garden tea party!I was surprised by this set! The jars were bigger than I imagined, came with a plastic and cork lid each, plus string. It's a huge set with so many pieces. I was expecting 6 jars and a handful of lids, but nope it's a full set of jars.Easy storage, Leak proof, not too heavy, I use this item for spell Jars, Fit, and Functional great, Very useful for just about anythingThese jars are amazing! I use it for my baby shower favors.Good quality. I used these for my wedding reception as part of the centerpieces, I placed fairy lights inside.
